title: Chest of the Mundane
summary: Items stored in this chest look like mundane objects until removed. The change does not reduce weight or affect corpses.

fields.Use: Store items to disguise them. Removing them or bringing a Sussur Bloom’s antimagic aura nearby negates the effect.
fields.Acquisition: Northern balcony of the main floor of the Arcane Tower in the Underdark.
fields.Contents: Mystra’s Grace, Scrolls of Mage Armour and Protection from Evil and Good, Gold Ingot, and Hearthlight Bomb.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence.
